instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, medium shot. Two men stand close together outdoors against a grey corrugated metal wall. On the left, the fair-skinned man in the teal t-shirt and pinkish-grey open shirt (R2) is shown in profile, leaning his left arm casually over his companion's shoulder while looking forward. On the right, the Black man in the light blue open shirt over a white t-shirt (R1) stands facing him, looking at him with a calm, attentive expression. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight, highlighting the cool grey tones of the background.
